items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: The way the fellows used to get him. And they'd get me because they knew I was good. And they'd go play over here at the Beater's place

ctx.x: You see, the fellow that I used to often come in contact with is Yellow Nunez. I was telling you about him. He's the first man I ever heard playing jazz. You understand? The way the fellows used to get him. And they'd get me because they knew I was good. And they'd go play over here at the Beater's place on music and play ball. And they'd play all around. You understand?
What kind of a place was that? Just a tavern, bar room?
